moss-local: raw 48 kHz vs Sidon-processed — identical takes

What to listen for. moss-local outputs native 48 kHz. the production pipeline downsamples to 16 kHz and reconstructs 48 kHz through sidon's DAC vocoder — an upgrade for the 24 kHz 8B model, but a 48k→16k→48k round-trip for this model: real high-frequency detail is replaced by vocoder-synthesised highs, which reads as an "auto-tuned / denoised" sheen. same take, left raw, right sidon.
